verdict.rationale: Babylon.js documents a production 3D renderer: 'best-in-class' PBR, clustered lighting, a full scene graph with lights and materials, and WebGL 1/2 and WebGPU backends. Community users corroborate that it has broad rendering capability and good performance. Only PBR and the lighting system are actually evidenced, so most of the story's named features remain unproven in this pack. Missing for 10: evidence of shadow mapping, post-processing pipeline, global illumination or baked-lighting/lightmap support, and in-depth renderer docs.
